title: 第28章 透视眼带来的刺激
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
“呃！”李大壮只觉得浑身燥热，恨不能立刻将徐晴按倒，先在沙发上收拾她一顿！

    可徐晴却娇笑着，用胸前雪峰撞了撞他：“小色狼，先忙正事儿，姐又不会跑~~”

    “晴姐，我可不小！”李大壮不满道。

    “呃！好好好！你不小！你最大了~~”徐晴笑的更欢了，美眸仿佛能拉丝，紧紧粘在李大壮的……

    这下倒是轮到李大壮不好意思了，连忙并拢双腿，捂住……

    “怎么？不想让姐看？刚才在清水镇，姐可不光看了，都摸了……”

    “晴姐别说了，不是要签合同吗？给我笔吧！”李大壮被她逗的脸都红了，连忙转移话题。

    谁知徐晴却笑的更暧昧了：“笔？你要……什么笔？是办公桌上的？还是我身上的……”

    “晴姐！”李大壮嗓子都在冒火，这女人咋一点都不知道害羞，好歹还是个大姑娘呢，啥都敢说：“你身上的笔，又不能写字？”

    “谁说的！”徐晴嗔瞪了他一眼，竟伸手在胸前掏出了一支签字笔：“姐忙的时候就喜欢把笔放这儿，拿着方便。”

    “倒是你，刚才想哪儿去了？”

    “我……”李大壮彻底无语了，敢情徐晴说的不是那个……笔啊！

    “呵呵呵~大壮，我发现逗你真好玩！”徐晴笑的花枝乱颤，嘴上却说：“好了，不笑你了，不过你也别急着签字，先看完再说！”

    “我已经看完了，没问题！”

    “这就看完了？你刚才不就只看了一眼吗？”徐晴终于不笑了，严肃道：“大壮，姐告诉你，合同这东西不是别的，签了就具有法律效益，你不看仔细里面的内容就签字，很容易被人卖掉还会帮人数钱！”

    “晴姐，我相信你不会舍得卖我，而且我真的看完了，不信我给你背背！”

    李大壮还真开始背起合同里的内容，由于徐晴确实没想坑李大壮，合同内容不多，他一口气就背完了！

    徐晴却听得目瞪口呆：“天呐！这些内容虽然是我写的，可我也背不了这么全，你竟然只看了一眼就全背下来了，你是天才吗？”
content_en:
Upon hearing this, the fat woman's brows deepened, and all the powder on her face was squeezed out. She glanced at Li Dazhuang with a look of disgust: "Turns out he is a country bumpkin who wants to defraud money! Leave quickly! We don't accept the ones we raise here, but we have to pretend to be wild old turtles!"

    "You didn't even look at it, how did you know that my old turtle was fake? You don't have to accept it, but you can't insult me!" Li Dazhuang looked cold!

    "Do you still need to look at me? I can tell just by looking at your country bumpkin outfit! A poor loser like you is the best at cheating money and sex. Go away quickly, I won't be fooled by you!"

    The fat woman pushed Li Dazhuang. Li Dazhuang turned sideways slightly. The fat woman missed him and almost fell to the ground!

    Li Dazhuang laughed: "It's impossible to cheat money, but it's possible to cheat sex, but unless I'm blind, I won't be able to cheat a fat pig like you in this life, so just keep it in your stomach!"

    "You! You bastard! You stinky loser! If you dare to call me a fat pig, I will scratch you to death!"

    The fat woman was like an angry elephant, baring her teeth and claws and rushing towards Li Dazhuang!

    This time, Li Dazhuang waited for the fat woman to throw herself forward before suddenly turning sideways. The fat woman had no time to retract her strength and finally fell to the ground!

    Li Dazhuang whistled happily!

    The fat woman was in pain and angry, almost going crazy, but the tonnage was too heavy. She lay on the ground like an old turtle that had rolled over, and she couldn't get up for a long time!

    This caused several medicine-buying customers to look sideways, covering their mouths and snickering.

    "What's the fuss about?"

    An impatient voice came from the second floor, and then a sexy woman wearing a slit cheongsam and stiletto heels came down.

    The woman is about thirty-five years old, plump and plump, with fair and smooth skin, no lines on her well-maintained face, and a swaying grace in her movements. She is a mature beauty. She is the proprietress of this pharmacy, Liu Yan!

    "Auntie! This little bastard bullied me! Uuuuuuuuuuuuu!"

    When the fat woman saw Liu Yan, she immediately pointed at Li Dazhuang and burst into tears.
title_en: Chapter 29 The beautiful and plump female boss in cheongsam
